growth.note: The bound applies to every fixture measured at more than one size, and it is 1.25 because the cost per plan entry has to stay flat as the fleet grows: `fleet` grows the number of entries and keeps each entry's own work constant, `mesh` grows one entry's work with the fleet and keeps the plan linear in it, and a quarter of slack absorbs constant-factor noise without admitting any super-linear term.

worked.note: Moved by two changes together: open-the-repository-to-a-consumer made the library record the identity of the package set whose platform definitions elaborated it, and identify-interfaces-by-declared-id gave an interface a declared id that a capability records where a claim was made. Both costs are constant per evaluation rather than per-entry work, which is why every figure moved by a fraction of a percent and the largest fixture moved least. Recorded from the sandboxed planner-perf-results measurement of the integrated tree.
